item.title: Intocable Receive Star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame: ‘Thank You for Putting Us Here’
item.description:
[Intro music plays, followed by the host's energetic voice]
Host: "Welcome to this special episode of 'Trending on Billboard'! Today, we're celebrating a major milestone in the music industry. The Texas-based group Intocable has just received its very own star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame! Located at 7083 Hollywood Boulevard, this star is the 2,852nd to be awarded in the recording category.
[Short music transition]
Host: "The 30-minute ceremony was attended by Latin hitmaker Edgar Barrera, Nir Seroussi, president of Interscope Capitol Miami, and journalist Jessica Maldonado, who served as the event's MC. Maldonado praised Intocable as 'true icons of Mexican-American identity and pioneers of modern Mexican music.' She also highlighted the group's impact on the Latino community, saying 'your success represents all those Latinos.'
[Short music transition]
Host: "Nir Seroussi also shared his admiration for the group, saying 'they didn't just build a legacy, they showed the world what música Mexicana could be.' And Edgar Barrera, a longtime fan of Intocable, recalled how the group inspired him to be proud of his 'border town' identity. He thanked them for 'guiding us and opening doors for us.'
[Short music transition]
Host: "Formed in the early 1990s, Intocable has had an incredible career, blending genres like Tejano, Norteño, pop, rock, and cumbia. With an estimated 55 million albums sold, 15 number one hits on Billboard's Top Regional Mexican Albums chart, and 21 number one hits on Regional Mexican Airplay, they're a force to be reckoned with. And let's not forget their numerous awards, including Grammys, Latin Grammys, and Billboard Music Awards!
[Short music transition]
Host: "In a heartfelt speech, Intocable's Ricky Muñoz thanked family, team members, fans, and composers for their support. He emphasized the importance of songwriting, saying 'everything begins with a song.' Congratulations to Intocable on this well-deserved recognition! You can watch the complete ceremony online and celebrate this amazing achievement with us.
[Outro music plays]
Host: "Thanks for tuning in to this special episode of 'Trending on Billboard'! Join us next time for more exciting updates from the music world."
